These are benchmark-qualified token prices, not cost per successful task, dollars per work hour, or raw unqualified token prices. No reasoning/non-reasoning comparison or benchmark splice. A model price change is a new dated observation; latest observation can substantially predate file update.

The source provides observation months only, anchored to the first day for charting. Component values and totals are rounded separately (e.g. December 2025 components sum to 48.6 but reported total is 48.5 GW). One utility territory; not a global AI power series. Contract-stage capacity is not measured electricity demand.
